visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with brown hair and a pinstripe blazer speaks directly to the camera in a professional studio setting. A digital overlay displays a news article about a chimpanzee named Raven. (2) The scene cuts to stock footage of the New York Stock Exchange facade and then a chimpanzee at a zoo, while the man remains in a small circular inset at the bottom. (3) Visuals of darts hitting a bullseye and a Guinness World Record certificate are shown to illustrate the chimp's investment success. (4) A monochrome filter is applied to the man as he gestures. Graphics of a crying office worker and a shocked primate face appear to represent the frustration of human investors. (5) A woman is seen in a lifestyle shot looking stressed at her laptop. This transitions into a bright, colorful graphic promoting an AI investment course by Hahow. (6) Close-ups of stock charts with a pen pointing at data and an infographic outlining AI workflow steps (automation, templates, reports) are presented. (7) A screen recording demonstrates an AI tool generating a financial analysis of Nvidia. The man continues narrating in the foreground with active hand gestures. (8) The man concludes by pointing towards on-screen text overlays showing a discount code and a promotional link call-to-action.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The narrator's energetic male voice begins with high clarity over a bright, synthesized pop BGM. A rapid 'whoosh' SFX signals the start. (2) As the topic shifts to the stock exchange, the speech remains fast while the BGM maintains a steady, rhythmic beat. (3) Three distinct 'percussive thuds' sync with visual darts, followed by a 'ding' bell sound as the Guinness record is mentioned. (4) A whimsical 'boing' sound effect plays to accentuate the humorous comparison between chimps and bankers. (5) The narrator transitions into a persuasive, professional tone. A 'pop' bubble SFX introduces the Hahow course graphic. (6) Rapid UI 'clicks' and 'digital swooshes' are layered in as the narrator describes the AI tool's technical capabilities. (7) The final phase features a triumphant 'sparkle' SFX for the discount announcement, with the BGM swelling slightly before a clean hard cut at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Historical Context -> Current Problem -> Solution -> Special Offer -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous historical anecdote about a stock-picking chimpanzee to grab attention and highlight the difficulties of manual stock investment. It then pivots to promote a specific AI-assisted investment course on Hahow, emphasizing efficiency and automation for modern investors.
